definitions.gloss: voter turnout; voting rate; percentage of eligible voters who cast ballots
definitions.explanation: The proportion of eligible voters who actually vote in an election, expressed as a percentage.

examples.japanese: {投票率|とうひょうりつ}が{低|ひく}い。
{今回|こんかい}の{選挙|せんきょ}の{投票率|とうひょうりつ}は{約|やく}50%だった。
examples.english: The voter turnout for this election was about 50%.

examples.japanese: {若者|わかもの}の{投票率|とうひょうりつ}を{上|あ}げるための{取|と}り{組|く}みが{行|おこな}われている。
examples.english: Initiatives are being undertaken to raise the voter turnout among young people.

notes:
Composed of {投票|とうひょう} (voting) + {率|りつ} (rate/ratio). A common term in news and political discussions, especially around election time.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {投票率|とうひょうりつ}が{高|たか}い — high voter turnout
- {投票率|とうひょうりつ}が{低|ひく}い — low voter turnout
- {投票率|とうひょうりつ}を{上|あ}げる — to raise voter turnout
- {投票率|とうひょうりつ}の{低下|ていか} — decline in voter turnout
- {過去最低|かこさいてい}の{投票率|とうひょうりつ} — record-low voter turnout

CULTURAL NOTE:
Japan has seen a general trend of declining voter turnout, particularly among younger voters. National elections typically see turnout around 50-60%, while local elections can be significantly lower. This has been a persistent concern in Japanese political discourse.

RELATED TERMS:
- {投票|とうひょう} — voting
- {選挙|せんきょ} — election
- {有権者|ゆうけんしゃ} — eligible voter
- {投票所|とうひょうじょ} — polling place
